name: A Little Forgiveness
source:
Lilly Sakuragawa, a literature student on her final semester, is doing research for her bachelor thesis. Help her focus on studies, and unravel her personal story of grief, loneliness, love, and forgiveness. 

[From [url=https://sippit.itch.io/a-little-forgiveness]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
樱川莉莉是文学系学生的最后一个学期，她正在为她的学士论文做研究。帮助她专注于学习，并讲述她关于悲伤、孤独、爱和宽恕的个人故事。

[来自[url=https://sippit.itch.io/a-little-forgiveness]itch.io[/url]]
